label: Painter and decorator
headline: Painting and decorating with a sharp, clean finish.
lead: Interiors, exteriors, woodwork and wallpaper. Call or message for a straight answer and a clear price.
meta_services: Interior and exterior painting, wallpaper and repairs.

Houses, fascias, gates and fences in paint suited to the weather.
Hanging and stripping, from feature walls to whole rooms.
A smooth finish on doors, skirting boards and kitchen units.
Cracks, holes and marks sorted before painting starts.
Landlord refreshes, shops and offices with minimal disruption.
steps: Tell us which rooms or areas. Photos help.
You know the cost before any work starts.
Finished to the timetable we agree, with floors and furniture left clean.
